summary: Answered both of your 11 Nov notes on the videos. The yellow glow is gone, things are bigger, and the script check now fails a Short that shows a figure the voice never says. Also reverted one test, started a faster-voice test, set new long-thumbnail rules, and fixed the camera cutting tags at the edges.
why: Your notes come first. The evaluator said revert for you-in-the-core-story (-97% views at 48 h). Edge cuts were the most common QA failure (26 Shorts in 14 days). Research's top adopt item was the long thumbnail, after 4 clicks from 100 impressions.

findings.title: Evaluator: 46 Shorts with 48 h data
findings.detail: you-in-the-core-story revert (-97%, n 2 vs 1). 4 others are still waiting: hook-voice-matches-frame (day 22 of 28, 12 vs 12), ending-beats-act-and-vary (day 8 of 21), quiet-bed and chart-gap-fill (need long videos).

findings.title: What wins on 48 h views
findings.detail: story how_they_make_money 9.77x (n 5); hook secret 9.77x (n 5); length 25-29 s 12.5x (n 5, 79% viewed). Myth (0.38x) and question (0.46x) hooks are weakest.

findings.title: Impact, latest week (2 Nov, n 8)
findings.detail: Median 48 h views 43 (211 the week before), 54.1% viewed (39.7%), stayed to watch 0.383 (0.388), 23.0 s average view (17.9). Retention went up, views went down.

findings.title: Why the Ohtani script was hard to follow
findings.detail: It showed the $700M deal, the deferred $680M and $125M from sponsors, but the voice never said them ('far more', 'a side cheque'). It spoke 70 words in 26.7 s (157 a minute).

findings.title: Top failure: edges cut
findings.detail: 26 videos, 90 QA notes in 14 days. The follow camera kept a thing inside a 60 px margin, but its tag and label sit outside the thing's box.

changes.title: Reverted you-in-the-core-story
changes.detail: The prompt was dropped; status set to reverted in both experiment files.

changes.title: No glow; one big thing; grows that show
changes.detail: The yellow halo is removed from remotion/src/studio/build.tsx. renderer/craft.py stage_problems runs in lint and the render gates. The README, SHOTS.md and the checklist are updated.

changes.title: Every figure on screen is said
changes.detail: generator/story.py spoken_figure_problems runs in the script check for Shorts. The checklist is updated.

changes.title: Started october-voice-pace
changes.detail: In half the Shorts the voice runs at 1.4 with 80-100 words, and the picture keeps its 1.2 tempo (renderer/timeline/build.py voice_speed). Judged on 48 h views, 8 per arm, 21 days at most.

changes.title: Long thumbnails that get clicked (adopt)
changes.detail: renderer/thumbs.py spec_problems now fails a calm face, more than 3 things, and a scale word the title doesn't use. The long_story README is updated.

changes.title: Follow camera keeps tags and labels in frame
changes.detail: Shots pushed in on a thing that carries text keep a 170 px margin. Stills on v-20261111-03 show it fixed at 10.5 s.
